sections.title: O que você vai aprender a dizer

blocks.text: Até agora você falava do que é agora: I am at home. Agora vai contar o que foi: «ontem eu estava em casa», «no Natal a gente estava junto», «tinha dois prendedores na sacola». Para isso a peça tem uma forma no passado.

examples.en: I was at home yesterday.
examples.translation: Ontem eu estava em casa.

examples.en: We were together at Christmas.
examples.translation: No Natal a gente estava junto.

examples.en: There were two clothes pegs in the bag.
examples.translation: Tinha dois prendedores na sacola.

examples.en: Was it warm in spring?
examples.translation: Fez calor na primavera?

blocks.text: A peça tem duas formas no passado. Onde era am ou is, agora é was: I was, she was, it was. Onde era are, agora é were: you were, we were, they were. Servem para «era», «estava», «foi», «esteve» — em inglês não precisa escolher. E sempre com quem no começo.

examples.en: I was at home yesterday.
examples.translation: Ontem eu estava em casa.

examples.en: She was in London last year.
examples.translation: Ano passado ela esteve em Londres.

examples.en: We were at home last night.
examples.translation: Ontem à noite a gente estava em casa.

examples.en: They were in London at New Year.
examples.translation: No Ano-Novo eles estavam em Londres.

examples.en: The hairdresser was busy yesterday.
examples.translation: Ontem a cabeleireira estava ocupada.

fixes.wrong: Was at home yesterday.
fixes.right: I was at home yesterday.

fixes.wrong: I were at home yesterday.
fixes.right: I was at home yesterday.

fixes.wrong: We was at home last night.
fixes.right: We were at home last night.

sections.title: Marcas do passado: yesterday, last night, on Sunday

blocks.text: Quase sempre há uma palavra que marca o passado: yesterday — «ontem», last night — «ontem à noite», last year — «ano passado». Para festas, at: at Christmas, at New Year. Para dias, on: on Sunday.

examples.en: I was at home on Sunday.
examples.translation: No domingo eu estava em casa.

examples.en: We were together at Christmas.
examples.translation: No Natal a gente estava junto.

examples.en: They were in London at New Year.
examples.translation: No Ano-Novo eles estavam em Londres.

examples.en: The sports centre was closed yesterday.
examples.translation: Ontem o centro esportivo estava fechado.

fixes.wrong: We were together in Christmas.
fixes.right: We were together at Christmas.

fixes.wrong: I was at home in Sunday.
fixes.right: I was at home on Sunday.

blocks.text: Se é sobre ontem, was ou were. Se é sobre agora, is ou are, como antes. A palavra yesterday ou now já indica: Yesterday my towel was wet. The shower curtain is dry now.

examples.en: Yesterday my beach towel was wet.
examples.translation: Ontem minha toalha de praia estava molhada.

examples.en: Yesterday my flip-flops were dirty.
examples.translation: Ontem meus chinelos estavam sujos.

examples.en: The shower curtain is dry now.
examples.translation: Agora a cortina do box está seca.

examples.en: The bathroom mirror was dirty yesterday.
examples.translation: Ontem o espelho do banheiro estava sujo.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday my beach towel is wet.
fixes.right: Yesterday my beach towel was wet.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday my flip-flops was dirty.
fixes.right: Yesterday my flip-flops were dirty.

drill.optionA: Yesterday my beach towel is wet.
drill.optionB: Yesterday my beach towel was wet.

sections.title: O que não se conta em unidades — was

blocks.text: Como na lição 4, o que não se conta em unidades — protetor, comida, suco — vai com a forma de um: was, não were. Yesterday the sun cream was in my bag.

examples.en: Yesterday the sun cream was in my bag.
examples.translation: Ontem o protetor solar estava na minha bolsa.

examples.en: The apple juice was cold yesterday.
examples.translation: Ontem o suco de maçã estava gelado.

examples.en: The hot chocolate was too sweet yesterday.
examples.translation: Ontem o chocolate quente estava doce demais.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday the sun cream were in my bag.
fixes.right: Yesterday the sun cream was in my bag.

fixes.wrong: The baby food were in the cupboard.
fixes.right: The baby food was in the cupboard.

blocks.text: Em português o «não» vem antes: «não estava». Em inglês o not vem depois da peça: It was not my day off. The fried egg was not cold. Para vários, were not.

examples.en: It was not my day off.
examples.translation: Não era minha folga.

examples.en: The fried egg was not cold.
examples.translation: O ovo frito não estava frio.

examples.en: The peanut butter was not on the table.
examples.translation: A pasta de amendoim não estava na mesa.

fixes.wrong: It no was my day off.
fixes.right: It was not my day off.

fixes.wrong: The fried egg didn't cold.
fixes.right: The fried egg was not cold.

blocks.text: A pergunta se monta como na lição 2: a peça na frente. Was it warm in spring? Were you at home in autumn? A resposta curta também com a peça: Yes, it was. No, it was not. Aqui não vai do nem did.

examples.en: Was it warm in spring?
examples.translation: Fez calor na primavera?

examples.en: Were you at home in autumn?
examples.translation: No outono você estava em casa?

examples.en: Was your pancake hot?
examples.translation: Sua panqueca estava quente?

examples.en: Were the scrambled eggs hot?
examples.translation: Os ovos mexidos estavam quentes?

examples.en: Yes, it was.
examples.translation: Estava, sim.

fixes.wrong: It was warm in spring?
fixes.right: Was it warm in spring?

fixes.wrong: Were your pancake hot?
fixes.right: Was your pancake hot?

fixes.wrong: Yes, it did.
fixes.right: Yes, it was.

blocks.text: Em português «tinha» serve para um e para vários, e é o verbo ter. Em inglês não se usa have: There was para uma coisa, There were para várias. There was a towel rail in the bathroom. There were two clothes pegs in the bag.

examples.en: There was a bed sheet on the bed.
examples.translation: Tinha um lençol na cama.

examples.en: There were two clothes pegs in the bag.
examples.translation: Tinha dois prendedores na sacola.

examples.en: There was a public toilet near the station.
examples.translation: Tinha um banheiro público perto da estação.

examples.en: There were two taxi drivers near the station.
examples.translation: Tinha dois taxistas perto da estação.

examples.en: There was fruit salad in the bowl.
examples.translation: Tinha salada de frutas na tigela.

fixes.wrong: Had two clothes pegs in the bag.
fixes.right: There were two clothes pegs in the bag.

fixes.wrong: There was two clothes pegs in the bag.
fixes.right: There were two clothes pegs in the bag.

blocks.text: Com was é fácil opinar sobre algo que passou: That was a silly idea — «foi uma ideia boba», The plan was sensible — «o plano era sensato». Para várias coisas, were: The rules were fair.

examples.en: That was a silly idea.
examples.translation: Foi uma ideia boba.

examples.en: The plan was sensible.
examples.translation: O plano era sensato.

examples.en: The rules were fair.
examples.translation: As regras eram justas.

blocks.text: Toda a gramática nova são duas formas: was para I, he, she, it e uma coisa; were para you, we, they e várias. O resto é igual a am, is, are.

sections.title: O que levar para a prática

blocks.text: Foi, estava: was ou were, sempre com quem. Não estava: was not, were not. Pergunta: Was…? Were…?, resposta: Yes, it was. Tinha: There was / There were. Ontem: was; agora: is.

examples.en: She was in London last year.
examples.translation: Ano passado ela esteve em Londres.

examples.en: It was not my day off.
examples.translation: Não era minha folga.

examples.en: Were you at home in autumn?
examples.translation: No outono você estava em casa?

examples.en: There was a soap dish next to the washbasin.
examples.translation: Tinha uma saboneteira do lado da pia.
